nestedStatements._reason: The rule counts tuple literals inside immutable neighbour lists and nested combinator lambdas as statements; this rejects AGENTS.md's mandated list expressions and compositional pipelines without measuring control-flow nesting.

reimplementsFunction._reason: FS3517 requires literal lambdas at InlineIfLambda call sites; this rule tells us to remove precisely those lambdas.

avoidSinglePipeOperator._reason: AGENTS.md requires left-to-right pipelines; a single pipeline remains the same data-flow convention.

maxLinesInLambdaFunction._reason: AGENTS.md mandates compositional solve function values and combined combinators; Fantomas expands them beyond seven physical lines, and extracting wrappers solely to meet a line count conflicts with KISS.

maxLinesInValue._reason: The new operation owns generated year registries; their one solver table necessarily grows with the registered solutions and cannot be split by hand.

genericTypesNames._reason: AGENTS.md uses idiomatic F# lowercase generic type parameters, including the shared parser's 'a.

unnestedFunctionNames._reason: AGENTS.md mandates lowercase solve/parse interfaces and module functions.

maxNumberOfFunctionParameters._reason: AGENTS.md requires hot loops to carry every state component as parameters, avoiding allocating captured closures or per-step wrapper records.

favourStaticEmptyFields._reason: AGENTS.md explicitly requires list/array expressions; replacing [] with List.Empty contradicts that idiom.

avoidTooShortNames._reason: AGENTS.md explicitly uses x/y coordinates, n counts and generic type variables; mandatory two-character names reject these domain idioms.

ensureTailCallDiagnosticsInRecursiveFunc._reason: F# 10 rejects attributes on local let rec bindings (FS0010); AGENTS.md requires helpers local to their caller. Module-level recursive loops still carry TailCall, enforced by compiler warning FS3569.

favourNestedFunctions._reason: AGENTS.md explicitly requires module-level hot recursive loops to avoid per-step closure allocation; this rule would move those loops back inside callers.

disallowShadowing._reason: AGENTS.md mandates pattern matching and parse-at-the-boundary refinement; reusing a name for a matched or parsed value keeps the type refinement explicit without mutation.
